geometry_scope: all B1 geometries and every C-v2 temporary candidate including rejected and unchanged
sample_strata: B1 sources and C final/temporary status; union of independently hash-ranked strata; include parents of selected refined
semantic_scope: all 198 classes for requested geometries; preserve full B1 members separately
scoring_features: own per-class evidence, raw geometry/view metadata, continuous per-class overlapping-neighbor evidence; no learned legacy scores in feature matrix
legacy_scores: metadata only until nested exclusion and replay verified
nested_exclusions: outer holdout plus inner row fold for training-feature generation; transitive upstream selection, geometry and scores rebuilt under same exclusions
current_population_role: diagnostic/future evidence requests, not nested-supervised training input
ap_target: future evaluator-aligned strict > over existing evaluator thresholds .50 through .90; .25 separate
